project_metadata.title: AI-Driven Hyper-Local Business Advisory and Financial Structuring Assistant for Rural / Semi-Urban Micro-Entrepreneurs
project_metadata.target_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE) & Ministry of MSME
project_metadata.pilot_corridor: ADYPU (Ajeenkya DY Patil University, Charholi) to Lohegaon Central, Pune, Maharashtra

government_micro_finance_schemes.scheme_name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
government_micro_finance_schemes.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
government_micro_finance_schemes.target_beneficiaries: Urban and peri-urban street vendors, hawkers, small roadside kiosk owners

key_incentives.interest_subsidy: 7% per annum credited quarterly to bank account
key_incentives.digital_incentive: Monthly cash-back of ₹50 to ₹100 on digital transactions (up to ₹1,200/year)
key_incentives.credit_card: PM SVANidhi Credit Card facility for working capital after 2nd tranche repayment
key_incentives.ulb_transfer: Vendor mobility enabled for migration between municipal jurisdictions

government_micro_finance_schemes.nodal_agency: Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency Ltd. (MUDRA)

tiers.target_stage: Early startup, tiny retail, street stalls, entry-level kirana
Shop establishment, inventory buildup, POS machine, refrigeration
tiers.collateral: Covered under CGFMU (Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units)

tiers.target_stage: Retail expansion, bakery machinery, mini-supermarket setups
Enhanced limit for entrepreneurs who have repaid Tarun loans successfully

eligible_activities_in_adypu_lohegaon: Traders and Shopkeepers: Kirana, departmental stores, milk booths
Food Products: Small eateries, tea/coffee cafes, bakeries, sweet shops
Personal & Community Services: Xerox & DTP centers, salons, motorcycle & cycle garages, tailors, medical stores
government_micro_finance_schemes.working_capital_tool: MUDRA Card (Pre-activated RuPay debit card linked to loan account)

government_micro_finance_schemes.scheme_name: National Backward Classes & SC Finance Corporations (NBCFDC / NSFDC)
government_micro_finance_schemes.nodal_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE)
government_micro_finance_schemes.target_beneficiaries: Micro-entrepreneurs from Backward Classes, Scheduled Castes, de-notified and nomadic tribes

loan_schemes.name: Micro-Finance Scheme
loan_schemes.delivery_channel: State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs) and Regional Rural Banks

loan_schemes.name: General Term Loan Scheme
loan_schemes.purpose: Setting up sustainable self-employment ventures in services and small retail

capabilities: Single-window digital eligibility check for 13 credit-linked Government schemes
Instant digital in-principle approval from 125+ partner banks and NBFCs
Integration with UIDAI Aadhaar, PAN verification, and GSTN for paperless processing

local_banking_infrastructure.lead_bank_pune_district: Bank of Maharashtra (Head Office: Lokmangal, 1501, Shivajinagar, Pune)
local_banking_infrastructure.role: Convener of SLBC Maharashtra and manager of District Annual Credit Plan (ACP)
local_financial_access_points_adypu_lohe: Bank of Maharashtra - Lohegaon Branch & ATMs
State Bank of India (SBI) - Dhanori / Lohegaon Road Branches
HDFC Bank & ICICI Bank - Porwal Road / Lohegaon branches

Common Service Centers (CSC) / Banking Correspondents (BC) in Charholi Budruk
